深圳水貝：一克黃金做成金豆，和做成吊墜，價錢可以差近四倍。那為什麼有人願意付四倍？而賣回去的時候呢？2024年一位水貝商家告訴深圳的報紙：純金回收按當日金價，每克減10元，金豆、手鐲、吊墜一視同仁。只有那一克能拿回來。

本片取自 Carat Capital 的紀錄片《PRICED》第7集〈Why Young Chinese Are Buying Gold by the Gram〉，旁白為本報設計的合成語音。

Shenzhen, Shuibei: one gram of gold as a bean, or as a pendant at nearly four times the price. Why pay four times? And when you sell it back? A Shuibei merchant told the city paper in 2024 that pure gold is bought back at that day's price minus 10 yuan a gram, bean, bangle or pendant alike. Only the gram comes back.

From Carat Capital's documentary PRICED, episode 7, Why Young Chinese Are Buying Gold by the Gram (YouTube, 21 October 2026); the narration is the paper's own designed synthetic voice. Figures: Xinhua Finance (Dec 2025), Shenzhen Special Zone Daily (2024).
